intro: Camping 101: Herbalism introduces gatherers to the craft of fashioning incense candles from wild botanicals. It emphasizes the foundational rules of wilderness living, from building a proper campfire to leaving civilized towns behind before pitching camp.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Dere ya have it, ya be craftin' your very own Incense Candle. Most folk don't be carin' much for camps being set up in da center of town, so ya be needin' ta head into da wilderness if ya be wantin' to try it out.

No camp is complete without a campfire, mon. Ya be needin' one of dose before ya be startin' up your camp. Most cooks be teachin' ya ta make a fire. Check in with someone who can train ya in da culinary arts if ya haven't already learned da basics.
